thesis: Revenue evidence defeats an absent-demand argument, while both sides concede unknown normalised earnings, capacity returns and funding. Neither establishes present buying value or observed business impairment. Capacity expansion remains an investment hypothesis rather than a delivered return.
strongest_counterexample: Group H1 revenue grew 30% and Taiwan revenue grew 18% in TWD; independent demand growth plus constructive technical participation could support profitable expansion.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable disclosure shows positive recurring-profit growth after excluding other-income effects and CFO less maintenance/capacity investment above zero, together with funded utilisation of purchased capacity, resolving the central buy gates.
Taiwan local-currency revenue growth at or below zero in a subsequent comparable period would invalidate the retained demand-resilience claim.
evidence_gaps: Current debt, FCF and funding/utilisation of approximately RM118m capacity commitment.
Matched intrinsic valuation and verified quarterly-report publication date.
decisive_factors: Other income increased to RM11.217m from RM3.573m.
Local-currency revenue growth is independent operating evidence.
47.18x vendor trailing reference is not normalised intrinsic value.
